# Names and phrases the handbook has retired, one per line:
#   pattern | what to use instead
# The separator is a pipe with a space on each side, so a pattern can still use
# a bare | to mean "or".
# Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. CHANGELOG.md is not
# checked, because the history has to be able to say what things used to be
# called. Text inside `backticks` is skipped too, so a document can still quote
# an old name on purpose.

\bBuilder Nights?\b | "PATCH" (renamed in 1.1.1)
\bSlack\b | "Discord" (moved in 1.1.0)
\borganizers\b | "team" or "team members". There's one organizer role, the Founder and Executive Director (1.1.0)
\borganizer team\b | "the team" (1.1.0)
\b(an|a human) organizer\b | "a team member" or "a human on the team" (1.1.0)
\bthree-layer\b | "four-layer documentation model" (1.1.0)
